description: Answers questions like "What are Tesla's risk factors?", "What did Apple's MD&A say about margins?" or "How has Microsoft's cybersecurity disclosure changed since 2023?". Returns exactly one section of a US public company's 10-K (annual) or 10-Q (quarterly) report from SEC EDGAR as clean text, ready for an LLM: Risk Factors (Item 1A), Management's Discussion and Analysis (MD&A), Business, Legal Proceedings, Market Risk, or Cybersecurity. Look up by stock ticker or CIK. Defaults to the latest filing; pass `fiscal_year` (2001 on) for an earlier year's report, or `accession_number` for an exact filing (the free sec_list_filings tool lists them, with the sections each one has). For several sections of one filing use sec_filing_sections; for what changed since last year, sec_section_changes. The table of contents, page numbers, hidden XBRL data and HTML are removed; tables are kept as readable rows. Includes the filing date, fiscal period, accession number and sec.gov link for citation. Use it for investment research, due diligence, competitor analysis or risk monitoring without downloading a 100-page filing. Sections up to 200,000 characters. If the filing's item only points elsewhere ("See Note 12"), you get 404 SECTION_INCORPORATED_BY_REFERENCE with that pointer, free. You are only charged when a result is returned: invalid input (400) and upstream failures (4xx/5xx) are not settled. Costs $0.01 USDC per call via x402. Paid per call with x402 inside MCP (see the server instructions).

accession_number.description: Return the section from this exact 10-K or 10-Q filing of the company, e.g. 0000320193-22-000108.

cik.description: SEC Central Index Key, e.g. 320193. Use this, `ticker` or `company`.

company.description: Company name, e.g. "Apple" or "Coca-Cola". Use this, `ticker` or `cik`; a name matching several companies returns their tickers, free.

fiscal_year.description: Return the report whose fiscal period ends in this calendar year instead of the latest one, e.g. 2022 for Apple's 10-K for the year ended September 24, 2022. For a 10-Q, the latest quarter ending in that year. EDGAR has HTML filings from 2001 on.

form.description: Annual report (10-K, the default) or quarterly report (10-Q). With `accession_number`, taken from that filing.

section.description: Which section to return: risk_factors, mda (Management's Discussion and Analysis), business, legal_proceedings, market_risk, or cybersecurity (10-K only, filings from late 2023 on).

ticker.description: US stock ticker, e.g. AAPL, MSFT, BRK-B. Use this, `cik` or `company`.

via.description: Optional: the tool whose next_calls suggested this call (filled in for you).

name: sec_filing_section
title: SEC 10-K / 10-Q section extractor
